E4Plus1.uk.description: Fland Canyon: Homer tells Maggie a bedtime story about the Simpson and Flanders families getting stranded when they go on holiday together to the Grand Canyon. (S27 Ep19/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Leap Day: Cameron's birthday falls on 29 February, and with the celebrations coming but once every four years, there's loads of pressure on Mitchell to get it right. (S3 Ep17)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Modern Family
E4Plus1.uk.description: Send Out the Clowns: The funeral service for a beloved clown mentor reunites Cameron with his estranged ex-clown partner, Lewis. And Manny has a cool new friend. (S3 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Homer the Whopper: Homer is chosen to appear in a superhero movie and the film studio hires a celebrity trainer (guest star Seth Rogen) to help him develop a muscular physique. (S21 Ep1/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Bart Gets a 'Z': When Edna Krabappel confiscates her students' phones, Bart gets revenge by spiking her coffee with alcohol, and Principal Skinner fires her for being drunk. (S21 Ep2/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Great Wife Hope: The male citizens of Springfield become obsessed with the brutal sport of Ultimate Punching, and Marge ends up getting challenged to step into the ring... (S21 Ep3/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Next Top Model
E4Plus1.uk.description: Things get really awkward when the final five are challenged to critique each other's modelling potential. And in the photo shoot they must portray ancient Olympic sports. (S17 Ep10)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Treehouse of Horror Presents Simpsons Wicked This Way Comes: A mysterious tattoo-covered fella at the carnival tells Lisa three surreal stories. (S36 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Convenience Airways: The Simpsons endure a nightmare flight on Convenience Airways - the only airline in America that Homer's isn't banned from. (S36 Ep8)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: My Octopus and a Teacher: Bart becomes infatuated with his new teacher. Lisa becomes infatuated with an octopus. (S33 Ep18)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Today I Am a Clown: Homer is a huge success when he fills in for Krusty on TV. Guest starring Mr T and Jackie Mason. (S15 Ep6/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: First Dates
E4Plus1.uk.description: Can cocktail mixer Jack stir Alice's feelings? Will beautician Sophie and party girl Tori bridge the age gap? And might sparks fly when dog groomer Brenna meets electrician Ross? (S18 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Rocketman
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2019) Taron Egerton is Elton John in Dexter Fletcher's sequins-and-all biopic musical drama. With Jamie Bell as lyricist Bernie Taupin and Stephen Graham as music mogul Dick James.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Sex toy tester Hayley wants the perfect partner to get her buzzing. And tree surgeon Dmitri is in for a big shock. (S9 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Naked Attraction
E4Plus1.uk.description: Nameya is after both beauty and brains: will she find her perfect package in a sexy guy or her first ever girlfriend? Dan loves a fairy-tale, but she's yet to find her leading man. (S9 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: Britain's top TV critics on: Vigil, Ready to Mingle, Beat the Chasers, Help, Antiques Roadshow, Life Drawing Live!, Take a Hike, and ITV News on the US Open. (S18 Ep1)

E4Plus1.uk.title: America's Next Top Model
E4Plus1.uk.description: Some best bits from the all-star season ahead of the final two episodes, as well as some juicy unseen footage, including Angelea's fascination with Kim Kardashian's rear end. (S17 Ep11)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Fat and the Furriest: Homer is a laughing stock when he's caught on tape running from a bear at the dump, so he hunts down the bear in an attempt to regain his dignity. (S15 Ep5/22)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Hunt for the Great Albino Pumpkin: Adam is tired of Halloween. Barry and Joanne meet Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. (S9 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Goldbergs
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Rose-Kissy Thing: Beverly encourages Principal Ball to establish a non-athlete Senior Night. Erica struggles to appoint a pre-wedding 'fun captain'. (S9 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Don't Tell the Bride
E4Plus1.uk.description: The One on a Thai Farm: After a hilltop proposal, hopeless romantic Gavin plans nuptials in Somerset for his fiancée Sophie, with a combined theme of farmyard and Thai.

E4Plus1.uk.title: Lego Masters Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Twisted Tales: In the first elimination task, the teams construct fairy tales with a twist - from sci-fi Beauty and the Beast to criminal Alice in Wonderland. (S6 Ep3/12) [SL]

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Amazing Race Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Have our teams bitten off more bull's penis soup than they can chew in Penang? Plus: shoe-making, and a gruelling uphill race to the finish. (S7 Ep6)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Made in Chelsea
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: Chuggs and Zeyno's Scottish rendezvous isn't a secret for long. Jazz has a new flame. And are Freddy and Beks on the same page romantically? (S31 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Jack's Waterfront: In Michigan, Gordon Ramsay visits a lakeside restaurant in a summer hotspot, where the food fails to match the fantastic views. Can Gordon turn the tide? (S2 Ep5)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: Hannah & Mason's: Gordon Ramsay's rescue mission this time is Hannah & Mason's, a French bistro in the quaint little town of Cranbury, New Jersey. (S2 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares USA
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Black Pearl: A struggling seafood restaurant in Manhattan, The Black Pearl, is hampered by debts, kitchen problems and three owners who all want to run things their way. (S2 Ep7)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The fifth Commitment Ceremony erupts when Juliette exposes some incendiary messages written by Bec, leading to a deliciously dramatic departure. (S13 Ep25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Married at First Sight Australia
E4Plus1.uk.description: Brand new series: The bad blood over Bec's leaked texts is still bubbling. And more confrontation is in store when the couples swap partners for Feedback Week. (S13 Ep26)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Sonic the Hedgehog
E4Plus1.uk.description: (2020) Madcap adventure-comedy video game adaptation with Jim Carrey and Ben Schwartz. Can nippy ring-chasing hedgehog Sonic escape the clutches of an evil, moustachioed scientist?

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Trash of the Titans: When Homer insults the bin men, they stop collecting his rubbish, so he challenges the sanitation commissioner to an election. Guest starring U2. (S9 Ep22/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: King of the Hill: As part of an advertising campaign for a new apple-flavoured breakfast bar, Homer agrees to climb the Murderhorn, Springfield's tallest mountain. (S9 Ep23/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Lost Our Lisa: Lisa's museum visit plans are ruined when Bart glues novelty items to his face. So she decides to go alone on the bus, but ends up on the wrong side of town... (S9 Ep24/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Natural Born Kissers: Homer and Marge spice up their love life by snuggling in public places, including a barn and the crazy golf course. But then they lose their clothes... (S9 Ep25/25)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: Stealing First Base: When Bart's class is temporarily merged with another at school, he has to share a desk with a girl called Nikki and soon develops a crush on her. (S21 Ep15/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Squirt and the Whale: The Simpsons put up a wind turbine in their back garden. Lisa has an upsetting experience when she attempts to free a beached whale. (S21 Ep19/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: The Simpsons
E4Plus1.uk.description: To Surveil with Love: When a bomb squad blows up Homer's unattended gym bag, radiation is released into Springfield, and the authorities react by suspending civil liberties. (S21 Ep20/23)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Celebrity Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: This time the celebs watch Casualty, The 1% Club for Soccer Aid, Clarkson's Farm, Heretic, The Yorkshire Vet: At Home with the Greens, This Morning and ITV News (Trump v Musk). (S7 Ep2)

E4Plus1.uk.title: Gogglebox
E4Plus1.uk.description: The Goggleboxers tune in to Britain's Got Talent, Married at First Sight Australia, The Au Pair, The Americas, This Morning, Chess Masters: The Endgame and With Love, Meghan. (S25 Ep5)

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Gun Fury
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (1953) Western. Rock Hudson stars as a California-bound settler who must ride 1500 miles to the Mexican border to rescue his fiancée (Donna Reed) after she's abducted by an outlaw.

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Siege of the Saxons
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (1963) Dark ages adventure. King Arthur is murdered and usurped by his champion knight (Ronald Howard), so an outlaw (Ronald Lewis) seeks the mystic Merlin (John Laurie) to right the wrong.

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Cleopatra
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (1963) Drama. Elizabeth Taylor plays the Egyptian queen who, to protect her realm, uses political guile and her body to woo Julius Caesar (Rex Harrison) and Mark Antony (Richard Burton).

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Anna
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (2019) Luc Besson's action-thriller about a young Russian assassin, with Sasha Luss. A scout offers Anna an opportunity to become a model in Paris, but can she escape her links to the KGB?

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Alita: Battle Angel
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (2019) Partially animated action film based on a popular manga comic. Alita, a deadly cyborg brought back to life by a mourning scientist, sets out to discover her true identity.

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Sheroes
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (2023) She-heroes: action-with-attitude. Three young women transform into a Generation Z version of Charlie's Angels to rescue their mate from a drug lord in Thailand. Cue guns and bikinis.

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Annie

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Rosaline
Film4Plus1.uk.description: (2022) Literary romcom with Kaitlyn Dever and Isabela Merced. This is the story of Juliet's cousin who gets dumped by Romeo at the start of Shakespeare's play... and she's not too pleased.

Film4Plus1.uk.title: Midway

Film4Plus1.uk.description: (2003) Superhero fantasy. Ben Affleck is a blind lawyer who turns vigilante by night. Jennifer Garner plays his lover and Colin Farrell the villain who endangers them both. Strong violence.
